text:
Noah Williams: Quick flag - after promoting runtime-5.0.0 we started seeing sporadic fallback errors for models using adaptive-kv. Small but reproducible in us-east-1. Proposing a short, region-scoped runtime pin for the adaptive cohort while we confirm the kernel selector diff. Any objections?
Priya Nair: Can you paste an error and the affected model set?
Noah Williams: Samples: window 04:05-04:18 UTC. Models: adaptive-* cohort (approx 12 models).
```
2026-08-11T04:11:02Z host=us-east-1 req=rz12 level=error model=adaptive-chat runtime=5.0.0 msg="fallback: kv-mismatch after kernel-select"
2026-08-11T04:15:47Z host=us-east-1 req=rz18 level=warn model=adaptive-tldr runtime=5.0.0 msg="inconsistent-kv-block-size detected"
```
Priya Nair: Let's scope to region:us-east and models=adaptive-*. Keep a 1h TTL and a 2% canary on other regions so we still catch surprises. I'll open a 90m change window.
deploybot: /pin runtime runtime-4.9.7 scope=region:us-east models=adaptive-* reason="kv-mismatch-after-5.0.0" ttl=3600 canary=2% initiated_by=@Noah Williams
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-12321 scope=region:us-east runtime=4.9.7 models=[adaptive-*] ttl=3600s canary=2% initiated_by=Noah Williams. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-12321 hours=1`
release-coordinator-bot: Change window opened 04:30-06:00 UTC for investigation and possible rollback. Notifying SRE and on-call.
changelog-bot: Drafting changelog entry: "2026-08-11: Temporary regional runtime pin for adaptive-* models in us-east due to KV block mismatch on runtime-5.0.0 (PIN-12321)." I'll create PR once pin is live.
eng-sre: Suppressing noisy alerts for pinned cohort. Monitoring targets: kv-mismatch count, p95 latency, and OOMs every 5m. Posting telemetry snapshots here at :10/:25/:40/:55.
Priya Nair: Plan: bisect runtime 5.0.0 kernel selector flags -> reproduce on a repro node. If quick patch (<2h) we unpin and roll forward. If not, we'll keep the pin and backport a conservative selector.
Noah Williams: Also update internal release notes and ping PMs. I'll add a short customer-facing blurb for CS.
changelog-bot: Changelog PR created: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/12321. Please review for customer-facing language.
Priya Nair: Thanks all. Keep this thread for telemetry and the unpin decision. If any other region lights up, escalate here immediately.
